## Welcome!

I am a master's student in Biostatistics at Columbia University, with a focus on Data Science. I previously studied International Finance at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics.I also spent a semester exchanging at University of Notre Dame.

My interests include statistical modeling, machine learning, financial modeling, market research and applications of data science in finance and public health.

Outside of academics, I enjoy badminton,running, photography and playing the piano.

Learn more about my background on my [Resume](about.html) page.
